title: Give the Queen to the King
setup: Black's queen on b5 and rooks on b3 and e5 have your king in the corner, while its own king sits loose on d1.
hint: There is one square where your queen cannot be taken. Find it and see what the king has left.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qc2+}} steps beside the king untouchable — the rook on a2 defends it — and {{Ke1}} is forced. {{Qc1#}} follows. The most defensive move on the board turned out to be a queen offer.
